label: Diagram 4.7
caption: Diagram 4.7 Floor treatment 2 – wall treatment 1
description:
The image displays a cross-section drawing titled 'Diagram 4.7 Floor treatment 2 – wall treatment 1' in a green header at the top. The word 'SECTION' is located in the bottom right corner.

The drawing illustrates the junction between a vertical wall and a horizontal floor. On the left, the wall consists of a vertical column of eight stacked rectangles with diagonal hatching, adjacent to a vertical strip filled with a zig-zag wavy line pattern.

The floor extends horizontally to the right. It features a top surface line, followed by a rectangular layer with a dense cross-hatch pattern. Below this is a thick, solid horizontal band. Underneath the band is a wide cavity containing two distinct sections: a vertical area with an X-shaped brace on the left, and a series of connected, bulbous loop shapes on the right. The floor structure concludes with a thick, solid horizontal band at the bottom.
